title: Stable rerank crashes: score matrices must have the same shape
description: After excluding the query ticket the stable rerank step raises ValueError. It happens when the candidate pool is smaller than top_k.
logs:
ValueError: model_scores and tfidf_scores must have the same shape
  File "stable_rerank.py", line 38, in apply_stable_rerank_scores

title: Rank agreement is always zero when candidate_pool is 0
description: rank_agreement_row returns zeros for every candidate when the stable rerank candidate_pool is set to 0, so the agreement weight has no effect.

title: Average precision is wrong when relevant ids contain duplicates
description: average_precision counts the same relevant ticket twice, so MAP can exceed the expected value in evaluation reports.
